context:
Goal: one push guard per act, with no double refusals (your answers 206 a and 207 a, 2026-11-03).
Problem (rule): at 03:56 CST auto mode refused the lane's builder as Self-Modification. The edit turns off a banchi guard clause under Claude Code, and only your word in that session lifts it.
Based on (measured): the shared push guard now asks on a push to main and on a push of HEAD that lands on another branch name (claude-settings #1214, main 446f2d3d). Banchi's clause_push refuses the same acts. The one shape banchi refuses and the shared guard allows, `git push -u origin HEAD` with another upstream, lands on the local name (coordinator measure, 03:43 CST), so it is a banchi false alarm.
Based on (read): banchi already skips checkout, stash and reset under Claude Code for the same reason (banchi CLAUDE.md, the seven shell mistakes line).
Departs from: banchi main — GUARD_SHELL_SKIP=checkout,stash,reset becomes checkout,stash,reset,push under Claude Code; Codex keeps all seven clauses.

How to say yes: open the lane session and type: yes: edit banchi .claude/settings.json so the Bash hook runs GUARD_SHELL_SKIP=checkout,stash,reset,push
The red tests are on lane/banchi-push-guard-copies at 5a71f82. Meanwhile the lane waits; nothing else depends on it.
home: banchi .claude/settings.json; banchi CLAUDE.md (seven shell mistakes line)

options.gain: One ask per push instead of a refusal plus an ask; the -u false alarm ends under Claude Code.
options.how: Type the yes line in the lane session (link above). The lane edits banchi .claude/settings.json; Codex keeps all seven clauses.
options.label: Yes: banchi skips its push check under Claude Code
options.lose: Under Claude Code, a force push or a push to main goes from a banchi refusal to the shared guard's ask.

options.label: No: keep both checks
options.lose: Two checks per push, and the -u false alarm stays.

title: Let banchi skip its own push check under Claude Code?
why: Recommended: a. The shared guard already asks on every act banchi's push clause refuses, and the one act only banchi refuses is a false alarm.
